clips.title: The story
paras: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Solm Hargrin teaches rogues the quiet arts. The dwarf trains young dwarves and gnomes, and holds that honor among thieves matters as tensions rise across Azeroth.

Solm Hargrin trains rogues at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He welcomes young dwarves and gnomes, deciphers coded messages for them, and teaches techniques such as Eviscerate. Ironforge relies on mountaineers and warriors, but Solm knows some threats call for quieter methods. He teaches loyalty and honor among thieves as the world grows more unsettled.
